text: Come in, unless you're a salesman! … Oh, a Gooby. Hop onto the little bench, I'm just looking for my glasses.
(He is wearing one on his forehead, one around his neck and one in his mouth.)
Dr. Dr. Professor Dr. Dr.! Two degrees in medicine, one in cheese studies, and one … I found in an elevator.
Sick? SICK?! We'll fix that right away. Tongue out! … That's an ear. Also fine. Now say AAAAH.
Interesting. VERY interesting. I have no idea what that means.

nutella.text: ONE jar? Respect. I managed two as a student. Still: PRESCRIPTION!

niesen.text: Sneezing is just applause from the inside. But better safe than sorry: PRESCRIPTION!

text: (He stamps three times next to it, once on his own hand, then onto the prescription.)
Take this to Hilde at the GOOBYTHEKE. And tell her she still owes me a cheese sandwich. From 1987.

rezept_schon.text: You already HAVE a prescription! Says right here: cheese sandwich… er, Gooby Drops. Off to Hilde with you!

text: Fit as a fiddle! The heart pumps, the ears wiggle, the rest is accessories.
That'll be zero coins. Professional honor.
